name: Gravity Crane
author: ToastBubbles
description:
Harness the power of the Gravity Crane to help the technician escape these dangerous test rooms!

Hold Space to move, Tap Space to change direction.

Going to the trash bins is a good way to drop stuff!

Levels are selected randomly ((except the secret level of course)) ;)

More levels coming soon!

[Music is 8 Bit Space Groove! by HeatleyBros (Royalty Free of course)]
